title: smtp: IncomingMessage type and queue channel
description: Implement crates/smtp/src/queue.rs. Define: pub struct IncomingMessage { pub envelope_from: String, pub envelope_to: Vec<String>, pub raw_bytes: Vec<u8>, pub received_at: std::time::SystemTime, pub peer_addr: String }. Define: pub struct MessageQueue(tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<IncomingMessage>). impl MessageQueue { pub fn new() -> (MessageQueue, tokio::sync::mpsc::Receiver<IncomingMessage>) — creates unbounded channel; pub async fn enqueue(&self, msg: IncomingMessage) — sends on channel, logs warning if receiver dropped }. Tests: create queue, enqueue a message, receive it.
